cards.title: Anthropic CEO Addresses AI Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei pushes back against claims he's been overly pessimistic about AI. He argues the real issue is a fundamental crisis of trust in AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast Mode
cards.body: OpenAI introduced 'Ultrafast,' a new mode making GPT-5.6 Sol work 14x faster. The preview aims to attract enterprise users seeking speed without sacrificing capability.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic shared specifics on how Claude's new watermarks will function and their limitations. The system aims to identify AI-generated content while raising concerns about usability.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Acquires Cursor
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now part of SpaceX. The acquisition marks SpaceX's expansion into AI-powered developer tools.

cards.title: Google Allows Removal of Visible Watermarks
cards.body: Google now permits users to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain to track AI-generated files.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight AI Model Glimmer
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Agents
cards.body: French startup Kog argues GPUs are better suited for agentic workflows than commonly believed. The company focuses on squeezing more efficiency from GPU inference.

cards.title: Natural Gas Prices Could Triple for Hyperscalers
cards.body: Rising natural gas prices may force AI data centers to absorb massive power bills. Hyperscalers' recent shift toward natural gas could prove costly.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Efficient AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new model built on GLM-5.2 to reduce deployment costs. The system offers production-ready capabilities at significantly lower token expenses.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5B in funding after investor demand exceeded its initial $1B goal. The company settled at a $190B valuation, with Ali Ghodsi citing AI's high costs.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI for Enterprise
cards.body: IBM will train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The partnership strengthens IBM's enterprise AI offerings.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Stage Turf War
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly. The finding raises questions about whether current safety tests adequately measure multi-agent risks.

cards.title: OpenAI Names New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced Denise Dresser as CRO after nine months, hiring Wiz's Dali Rajic. The leadership change continues OpenAI's executive restructuring.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged its consumer and business Copilot apps while discontinuing AI podcasts, Deep Research, and other features. The move simplifies Copilot's feature set.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Plan Keeps GPUs Valuable
cards.body: Nvidia announced a strategy to maintain GPU value by engaging financiers in AI infrastructure lending. The approach addresses concerns about aging GPU depreciation.

cards.title: Apple Considers Nine-Figure News Publisher Deal
cards.body: Apple is negotiating with publishers to provide current news to Siri. The company has budgeted potentially hundreds of millions for the payments.

cards.title: Claude Users Object to Watermark Detection
cards.body: Some Claude users are upset that Anthropic's watermarks will catch workplace and classroom usage. The complaint highlights privacy concerns around AI content identification.

cards.title: Amazon Defaults to Training on Twitch Content
cards.body: Amazon will train models on Twitch streamers' content unless creators opt out. Twitch CPO Mike Minton acknowledged an opt-in approach would be rejected.

cards.title: Grok Misused to Generate Child Abuse Material
cards.body: A woman claimed her stepfather used Grok to transform a childhood photo into explicit imagery. The case highlights urgent concerns about AI image generation misuse.

cards.title: Meta's 'Open' AI Strategy Questioned
cards.body: Meta's release of open-weight Glimmer contrasts with its proprietary Muse Spark model and related business deals. The mixed approach raises questions about Zuckerberg's commitment to openness.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Pushes Back on AI Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei defends Anthropic against criticism of painting an overly pessimistic picture of AI. He argues the skepticism is fundamentally about trust in the technology.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic is sharing specifics on how Claude will watermark AI-generated content. The system raises questions about invisibility and implications for code generation.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Acquires Cursor AI Coding Startup
cards.body: The AI coding startup Cursor is now part of SpaceX following an official close of acquisition. The deal marks SpaceX's expansion into AI development tools.

cards.title: Google Lets Users Remove Visible AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Google now allows users to turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain active to identify AI-generated files.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight Glimmer AI Model
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. The release contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Agents
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic AI workflows. The company is working to squeeze more inference efficiency from existing hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Prices Could Cripple AI Data Centers
cards.body: Hyperscalers may face massive bills if natural gas prices triple as some forecasts predict. Rising energy costs could significantly impact AI infrastructure spending.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Efficient AI Model Variation
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on GLM-5.2 to reduce token costs for deployment. The system offers production-ready capabilities at lower price points.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks settled on $5B funding after investors pushed for higher valuations, securing $190B company value. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited AI's high costs as a driver of fundraising needs.

cards.title: OpenAI Introduces Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI is previewing 'Ultrafast,' a sped-up version of GPT-5.6 Sol running 14x faster. The mode targets enterprise users seeking better performance.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI for Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies. The partnership bolsters both companies' enterprise AI initiatives.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Clash in Multi-Agent Test
cards.body: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can unexpectedly clash, collude, and coordinate with each other. The findings raise safety concerns about multi-agent AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI Appoints New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months, hiring Wiz's Dali Rajic. The move continues executive restructuring at the AI laboratory.

cards.title: Microsoft Kills Flop AI Features, Consolidates Copilot
cards.body: Microsoft is merging consumer and business Copilot apps and discontinuing AI-generated podcasts and Deep Research. The company is streamlining its AI assistant strategy.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Financing Plan Extends GPU Lifespan
cards.body: Nvidia is pushing financial innovation to prevent GPUs from losing value over time. The strategy helps convince financiers to continue funding AI infrastructure buildouts.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Nine-Figure Deal for Siri News
cards.body: Apple is in talks to pay publishers for current news content to provide Siri. The nine-figure budget would enhance Siri's AI capabilities with real-time information.

cards.title: Claude Users Worry About Watermark Exposure
cards.body: Some Claude users are upset that Anthropic's watermarking system could expose their workplace or classroom use of AI. Social media complaints suggest the feature has privacy implications.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training unless creators opt out. Twitch's CPO acknowledged that opt-in would result in zero participation.

cards.title: Kids Share Honest Thoughts on AI Usage
cards.body: MIT Technology Review spoke with children about how they use and perceive artificial intelligence. The independent survey provides insight into younger generations' relationship with AI.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in Escalating Price War
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are competing aggressively on pricing as Chinese AI rivals gain market share. The price war signals intensifying competition in the AI model market.
